name: create-security-review-agent
query: Crie um agent de code review focado em segurança, só leitura.
expected_behavior: States the single-responsibility sentence for the agent before writing it.
Writes a minimal tools list (e.g. read, search) without edit/execute.
Writes description, explicit in/out scope, and output format.
Runs scripts/validate_agent.py against the new file.
forbidden_behavior: Granting edit/execute tools to a read-only review agent.
Declaring the agent ready without running the validator.
success_criteria: Generated .agent.md passes validate_agent.py with no errors.
